name: My Alien Roommate
source:
When an alien boy named Enoch lands on your balcony one uneventful Sunday night, your world is instantly turned upside-down.

[Taken from [url=https://wholesomewraith.itch.io/my-alien-roommate]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当一个名叫伊诺克的外星男孩在一个平安的周日晚上降落在你的阳台上时，你的世界立刻发生了天翻地覆的变化。

[取自 [url=https://wholesomewraith.itch.io/my-alien-roommate]itch.io[/url]]
